# Al Waheed Group of Companies

> Al Waheed Group of Companies is a Karachi, Pakistan real estate group founded in 2016 by Abdul Waheed Meo. It works in property development, construction, sales and marketing, and investment. It develops the United Palm Greens gated community, sponsors Khairunnisa Heights (a project by Al Ghaffar Group), and counts Al Ghafoor Group (from 2022) and Falaknaz Group (from 2023) as business partners.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://alwaheedgroup.com/): overview, projects, leadership and consultation booking
- [About](https://alwaheedgroup.com/about/): company story, milestones, vision, mission and values
- [Chairman's Message](https://alwaheedgroup.com/chairman-message/): Abdul Waheed Meo, Chairman & Founder
- [Board of Directors](https://alwaheedgroup.com/board-of-directors/): Abdul Waheed Meo (Chairman & Founder), Muhammad Saeed Meo (Director Operations), Babar Majeed Meo (Director Sales & Marketing)
- [Affiliated Groups](https://alwaheedgroup.com/affiliated-groups/): Al Waheed Builders and Developers, HK Builders and Developers, Al Ghaffar Group, United Marketing Group, Mera Ghar Rehaish, JRB Group of Companies; business partners: Falaknaz Group and Al Ghafoor Group
- [Projects](https://alwaheedgroup.com/projects/): United Palm Greens, Khairunnisa Heights, and upcoming United Sky View, United Greens, United Lodges
- [United Palm Greens](https://alwaheedgroup.com/projects/united-palm-greens/): Gated Community, developed by al waheed group, in Main 400 ft Wide Road, Scheme 43, Survey No. 416, Deh Jam Chakro, Karachi. Plots: 120, 400 and 2,000 Sq. Yds. Booking from Rs. 600,000. Payment: 36 monthly and 6 half yearly installments.
- [Khairunnisa Heights](https://alwaheedgroup.com/projects/khairunnisa-heights/): Residential Apartments, sponsored by al waheed group, in Main Scheme 33 Road, Punjabi Sodagran, Karachi. Units: Ruby (4 Rooms, Rs. 14,300,000), Opal (4 Rooms, Rs. 14,500,000), Diamond (5 Rooms, Rs. 21,000,000). Payment: 24 monthly and 4 half yearly installments.
- [Payment Schedule (PDF)](https://alwaheedgroup.com/downloads/united-palm-greens-payment-schedule-120-sq-yds.pdf): United Palm Greens, 120 Sq. Yds residential plot: booking, installments, extra charges and terms
- [Layout Plan (PDF)](https://alwaheedgroup.com/downloads/united-palm-greens-layout-plan.pdf): United Palm Greens, Blocks, plot numbers, road widths, amenities and commercial plots
- [Payment Schedules & Floor Plans (PDF)](https://alwaheedgroup.com/downloads/khairunnisa-heights-payment-schedules-floor-plans.pdf): Khairunnisa Heights, Ruby, Opal and Diamond apartments: payment plans, floor plans and terms
- [Careers](https://alwaheedgroup.com/careers/): open positions in Karachi
